title: Tattersall's Limited - proposed acquisition of Golden Casket Lottery Corporation Limited
industries: Lotteries and gaming machine monitoring services

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC and Tattersall's enter into undertaking negotiations. ACCC timeline suspended.
87B undertaking accepted by ACCC. ACCC decided that it would not intervene pursuant to section 50 of the Trade Practices Act.
